profile.overview: Azucena, the Peruvian coffee queen, is a simple, stance-oriented mixup character who thrives off of entering her Libertador (LIB) and Backturn (BT) stances to attack her opponents. Both stances have a diverse set of mixup options, frame traps and pressure tools that allow Azucena to maximize her damage from stance entries in a variety of ways. She can also trick her opponent using the stances' parries and built-in movement options to dance around them.
strengths: Simple inputs and easy to use stance moves.
Amazing 10 frame wallsplating punisher to setup stance mixups or keep pressure going.
Vast amount of wallsplating moves giving easy access to her devastating oki setups at the wall.
Great heat engagers that can be used in multiple ways; punishment, mixups, pressure, counter hits and to shut down sidestepping.
Good set of panic and evasive moves to escape pressure and stance mixups (e.g., f+1+2, db+3+4)
weaknesses: Strings have very limited follow-ups, with most exclusively only having duckable highs.
Slow and telling recovery makes her keepout risky and an easy target for whiff punishment.
heat: During libertador in heat: Powered up auto-parries, new move (LIB.d+3+4), parries and walking forwards or sideways regains heat
